name: jait.todos
description: Manage persistent repository follow-ups on the Todo page. Use todo for the current chat’s temporary plan.

repoId.description: Explicit repository ID. Omit to infer it from the current projectRoot.

todoId.description: Todo ID. Required for action=update or action=remove.

message.description: Future user message or task to save. Required for action=add.

dueDate.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use an empty string to clear it.

tags.description: Optional lowercase tags for grouping/filtering todos.
